title: Add cmd_bash, cmd_ps, cmd_bat attributes to genrule

timeline.body:
Based on https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/9022

Users now can use Batch or Powershell command in genrule on Windows. 
The attributes have the following priority:
`cmd_ps` > `cmd_bat` > `cmd_bash` > `cmd`, but `cmd_ps` and `cmd_bat` will only be taken into consideration on Windows.

Fixes #7503

timeline.body: How about `WINDOWS_CMD_EXE`?
How about `WINDOWS_POWERSHELL`?

No need to check if it's explicitly defined. It's enough to check if it's empty or not. An empty command cannot possibly make sense (it cannot generate any outputs, so the action would fail anyway), so we can ignore `cmd_ps` if the user deliberately sets it to `""`. 

Same for other attributes.

reply.body: That was exactly what I did. But I broke some tests because `cmd` is no longer a mandatory attribute. So I also want to ensure at least one cmd attribute got specified. If I don't use `isAttributeValueExplicitlySpecified`, I cannot tell the value is empty is because the attribute is not set or it's deliberately set to "". And as you said, setting an cmd attribute to "" doesn't make sense, I prefer to not silently ignore it.
